opportunities.title: Synthesis grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 with a diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation, demonstrating EDI principles.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by bringing together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis over two years, producing outputs to inform decision-making.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: £500 per year for a decade; first five years' funding (£3,500) claimed in year 1, additional £3,500 in year six

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners (e.g. Reserve Managers, consultants) as well as university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Supporting the launch of new long-term ecological studies by funding a small amount each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects to continue into the long term, covering projects such as ecological restoration, habitat creation and control of alien species anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level (early years to lifelong learning, formal or informal settings); awarded to individuals, not organisations; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by funding research on education methods within ecology to develop evidence informing teaching and learning practices.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; placements up to 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding placements/secondments up to £20,000 that immerse an ecologist in a distinctly different discipline or sector to build interdisciplinary skills and collaboration.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Member-only grant; funding for researchers from all countries globally, projects can be conducted anywhere in the world; PhD students subject to further eligibility criteria.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding for individuals, teams and organisations to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities that engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: Maximum of £250 for virtual conferences/courses; maximum of £500 for events in person

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher; postdoctoral researchers, undergraduates and masters students not eligible; must work or study at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Helping PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses, or the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must have applied to present at the BES Annual Meeting; must be at least three years since last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supporting researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel from and return to their country of residence.
